name: admin-leads
doc: The shared lead dashboard on accounts' /admin/leads (the owner, 2026-11-08: "make the shared lead dashboard be in the admin dashboard, not in one of the products"), and everything about a lead is done there (the owner, 2026-11-12: "i want https://accounts.openfrequency.co.il/admin/leads to have everything i need for creating and doing leads ... it MUST not send me to old fronts like https://accounts.openfrequency.co.il/admin/teder/leads"): nothing here links to Toran's or Teder's own operator pages, only to the store's site and to the demos' own public pages. Toran keeps the outreach and talks to Teder about the same store (its src/ops/leadsAdmin.ts, tederLeads.ts); accounts shows one list for both products and one page a lead, and every button is handed to Toran. A store is said in a few words (the owner: "i want each store to have a short description, so that i will know if i should build toran/teder/both/neither for that store"): about, its line in its own words from its home page (null when it says nothing its name does not), and facts, what Toran found of it: products (read from the store, else counted when it was found; productsAtLeast when that count stopped), priceMin and priceMax once read, the kinds most of its products are, and its own Instagram, TikTok and Facebook. Nothing in them is guessed or written by a model. A demo's state is none, building, review (built, waiting for the operator's look), ready (up, its pageUrl set), failed or removed; idea is what Teder's demo is about, null for Toran's. where is new, ready, sent, talking or closed. Each row says what can be built for it now (build: toran, also again once its page is built; teder, when it has no demo or one that failed or was removed; both, while neither has one and nothing is being built) and which demo the operator chose to make for it on this dashboard (chosen: toran, teder or both, null when none was; the owner, 2026-11-11: "each leads should have a button for generating a demo for teder/toran/both. the message that is suggested being sent to the phone number on whatsapp should be according to that"). What the lead goes on with is chosen whatever is built (build.go: for both, toran and teder, can, whether it can be chosen, and makes, the demos choosing it would make now, empty when it lacks none; POST go-both, go-toran or go-teder keeps the choice as it is said and makes only those; go-none is neither: the store is skipped, and Teder's lead of it marked not relevant; the owner, 2026-11-12: "i dont see a button for going on with teder/toran/both for each lead"). On one lead, send.options puts the chosen one first when it can go, else both when both can. Each of bothText, toranText and tederText is that message when it is due (null when not): the approved template's words when it goes from our number (pitchable), else the text to copy and send by hand, each demo's link in it; copy is the chat or the mail to open it in, with no text in it. review is Toran's page as it is checked on the lead's page (null before it is built): what holds it back (gaps, each key name, color, products, sample, price, of_number or demo_number, with Toran's line), whether it is approved or held back by hand since it was built, whether it is being built now, the name and colour it shows and the colours found on the site, the sample chat and what its last build turned down. ok false is a refusal in Toran's own words (error, in Hebrew), which accounts shows as it is.
